content:
What are your favorite quickbooks alternatives?? I am TIRED of them raising their fees. It's a whole $60 MORE than it was from when I first started using them 4 years ago....
I'm dropping Quickbooks as a processor, etc. I'm DONE! They have raised their fees SOO so high and their support is crap... services are being added that I don't want BUT I am paying for non-the-less... and AI is taking over their service support. 

I just had a client who paid via bank draft, but it was declined so it was reversed later "by quickbooks" .. so they paid me.. then took it back... THEN charged me a $25 fee for it!! For THREE SEPARATE transactions!! So now I owe them not just $75 is processing fees from my client's being a crap paying client (not even my fault)... I NOW have to pay back the money yhey paid me from those three transactions... ,which I already spent on bills.

OH OH and to make it better they kept trying to process his payments and I kept getting fees. I am up to almost $400s in fees for like $200 is actual invoices. They are telling be they cannot do anything about the fees and it is my clients responsibility to pay me those fees, by me invoicing them to pay said fees... WHAT?? So now I have to get documentation on said fees, re-invoice my client for said fees, only to pay quickbooks back said fees. I am NOT their maid for the fees they continued to accure because they continued to bill a client whoes bank kept denying the payments. WHY KEEP DOING THAT??

Quickbooks is the biggest scam there is out there.. do yourself a favor a leave. I have multiple businesses and they just lost themselves a regular multi business / many loyal years client to this nonsense.   

  
SO PLEASE give me some alternative options out there to use that do not charge outrageous fees and memberships. I'm about to just go back to old school outlook for invoices and excel.
